Co-expression modules (WGCNA)

Network is built on ComBat-seq then VST (protecting the grouping variable). DESeq2 itself still uses raw counts with batch in the design.

Reproduce WGCNA with this package module:

wgcna_out <- run_wgcna_pipeline(dds_qc, var = "condition")

Soft-thresholding power

Selected power: 3 (fallback_best_fit). Selection is capped at 15; the diagnostic plot still shows candidate powers through 20.

Module genes

All genes assigned to each co-expression module, sorted by absolute module membership (|kME|). Each table includes the full module membership and shows the top 10 by default. Use the tabs below to show one module table at a time. Download the CSV for the active module. The “Unassigned” module (WGCNA’s “grey” catch-all) is omitted here because it has no coherent expression profile.

Module PPI connectivity

STRING protein-interaction subgraph among each module’s member genes (ranked by |kME|). BioNERO-style layout: Louvain communities, degree-sized nodes; hover any node for its gene name. Top hubs stay labelled. Module genes with no STRING edge to another member are omitted. Use the tabs to show one module network at a time.

Reproduce module PPI connectivity with this package module:

ppi_out <- run_ppi_pipeline(
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out, wgcna_out = wgcna_out
)

Per-module pathway enrichment

Over-representation analysis (fgsea::fora()) of each co-expression module’s genes against every requested MSigDB collection (same collections as GSEA). Outer tabs select the module; inner tabs select the collection (same layout as pathway enrichment). The “grey”/Unassigned module is excluded throughout.

Per-module ORA is included in the WGCNA module call above:

wgcna_out <- run_wgcna_pipeline(dds_qc, var = "condition")
# results: wgcna_out$ora_by_module[[collection]][[module]]
